capabilities: authenticate with OneDrive personal or Entra ID accounts
sync vault files bidirectionally on file changes
resolve sync conflicts with overwrite, duplicate, or manual resolution
sync Obsidian settings, plugins, snippets, and bookmarks across devices
exclude files and folders via a .syncIgnore file
extras: The author works on the OneDrive team at Microsoft but states this is not an official Microsoft plugin. Pull-Only Mode is labeled experimental. Pre-release builds are available via BRAT. Entra ID accounts require a one-time Azure app registration by the user. Upgrading from 1.0.x requires disconnecting and reconnecting.
intentEvidence: Why this over native OneDrive file sync?
motivation: The author, who works on the OneDrive team at Microsoft, built it because it was 'just a thing I needed and wanted to share'.
problem: Obsidian's built-in sync options don't cover OneDrive, and native OneDrive file sync uses last-writer-wins and syncs device clutter like workspace state files.

relations.evidence: Sync your Obsidian vault with OneDrive. Zero-config for personal Microsoft accounts

requires.name: Microsoft account (personal or Entra ID work/school)

summary: Two-way sync of an Obsidian vault with OneDrive personal or work/school accounts, using event-driven sync with configurable conflict resolution.
